name: paylane
description: Paylane — virtual top-up and utility payments platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @paylane/api" "npm run dev -w @paylane/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @paylane/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @paylane/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @paylane/api && npm run build -w @paylane/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @paylane/api && npm run typecheck -w @paylane/web
